title: Set up the calendar's default view
summary: Choose how the calendar opens: mode, view (day, week, month…), grouping, branch, hour size, slot duration, appointment text and hidden days.

inputs.view: Day | 2 Days | 3 Days | Week | Month | Agenda
inputs.label: Appointment text format

steps.title: Calendar settings
steps.details: They're each user's preferences: they save automatically when changed and apply right away.

steps.title: Calendar mode
steps.details: Invoke shows the calendar as usual. Custom shows one calendar at a time in full screen; use the 'Calendars' button (top left) to choose which one to view.

steps.title: Default view
steps.details: Sets which view opens with the calendar (day, week, month, agenda…). Changing it applies the view right away.

steps.title: Group by
steps.details: Splits the calendar into columns by doctor or by room. 'No grouping' shows a single combined column.

steps.title: Branch
steps.details: Limits the calendar to one branch's rooms. 'All branches' shows every room.

steps.title: Hour height
steps.details: Vertical space for each hour in the day and week views. Taller = more space between appointments and more visible free gaps. Zoom multiplies this value and the slot duration divides it: below it shows how many pixels each slot ends up measuring.

steps.title: Slot duration
steps.details: Length of each slot (10, 15, 20, 30 min or 1 h). Sets how many slots fit in an hour: the more slots, the thinner they are within the configured hour height. If they're too tight, raise the hour height or the zoom.

steps.title: Appointment format
steps.details: Sets how the text shown on each appointment is built (time, patient, treatment, notes).

steps.title: Hide days
steps.details: Hides the chosen days as columns in the day and week views. It's only visual, to save space: it doesn't affect availability or the days appointments can be booked.

steps.title: Color by status
steps.details: Appointments show their status with color. If the appointment has its own color label or its service's color, it keeps it and the status shows as a strip on the left edge. If it only inherits the doctor's or room's color, the whole appointment is painted with the status color. Some statuses are set to always paint the appointment regardless of this preference — see Setup → Calendar Colors.
